tasks.label: git-status
tasks.command: cd /home/christianrafferty/Documents/projects/mailing_list && git status --short && echo '---' && git remote -v

tasks.label: git-diff
tasks.command: cd /home/christianrafferty/Documents/projects/mailing_list && git status --short --untracked-files=all && echo '---' && git diff -- src/index.html src/server.js package.json README.md .gitignore | sed -n '1,220p'

tasks.label: verify-app
tasks.command: cd /home/christianrafferty/Documents/projects/mailing_list && (node src/server.js > /tmp/mailing-list.log 2>&1 &) && for i in $(seq 1 20); do if curl -sSf http://127.0.0.1:3000/ >/tmp/mailing-list.html 2>/dev/null; then echo 'HTTP_OK'; head -n 5 /tmp/mailing-list.html; break; fi; done; pkill -f 'node src/server.js' || true

tasks.label: git-check
tasks.command: cd /home/christianrafferty/Documents/projects/mailing_list && echo 'repo:' && git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree && echo '--- tracked files ---' && git ls-files src/index.html src/server.js package.json README.md .gitignore && echo '--- status ---' && git status --short --untracked-files=all

tasks.label: git-commit-check
tasks.command: cd /home/christianrafferty/Documents/projects/mailing_list && echo 'HEAD:' && git log --oneline -1 && echo '---' && git status -sb && echo '---' && git diff --stat

tasks.label: git-fetch-history
tasks.command: cd /home/christianrafferty/Documents/projects/mailing_list && git fetch origin && echo '--- branches ---' && git log --oneline --decorate --graph --all -12

tasks.label: git-rebase-push
tasks.command: cd /home/christianrafferty/Documents/projects/mailing_list && git pull --rebase origin main && git push origin main
